task: Stop reporting a failed ioreg GPU read as 0 (D22): get_system_metrics gpu_usage_percentage and gpu_memory_used_gb become Option and the UI shows them as unavailable; verify at hermetic unit/static scope only.

events.summary: metrics.rs: the two SystemMetrics fields and the GpuTelemetryBackend::read result become Option, omitted from JSON when None (matching the existing '?: number' in src/types/ipc.ts); every failure path (ioreg missing, exec failure, non-zero exit, unparseable output) yields None, a parsed zero yields Some(0.0), and the two values are judged independently. MetricsPanel.tsx and Header.tsx drop '?? 0'. Docs updated: docs/02 FR-05.4 and the get_system_metrics row, docs/04 section 7, mistakes-log. Out of scope: the 'unstarted' wording at docs/04 lines 138 and 193, ioreg multi-accelerator handling, clamping values above 100.

Found while documenting #11: parse_ioreg_accelerator returned None on failure but get_metal_gpu_metrics turned it into (0.0, 0.0), as did its three early-return paths, and the frontend filled '?? 0', so a failed read looked like an idle GPU while thermal alone showed 'unavailable'. Fail-first evidence is weak: the new tests were run against the old code and failed only at compile time (E0271 Option mismatch, E0425 missing gpu_readings and assemble_metrics), not at runtime.

Option end to end. Header.tsx also changed from hiding the chip at 0 to showing it whenever the value is defined, so a measured idle 0% is now visible; this was not requested and is flagged for the owner.

make verify exit 0: 451 Rust tests passed, 2 ignored (opt-in on-device MLX), cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, tsc, vite build and DESIGN.md lint pass. An independent Opus review found no blocker or major: no other reader of the payload exists in Rust, scripts or docs, useMetrics.ts replaces state wholesale so a failed read cannot leave a stale GPU value, serialization tests assert both omission on None and presence on Some(0.0). Review gaps recorded: no test drives the three real failure branches of get_metal_gpu_metrics back to (Some(0.0), Some(0.0)); readings under 5 MiB round to 0.00 GB.

Not observed: the running app, a real ioreg failure, and the rendered UI (the repo has no frontend test runner; the change is type-checked and built only). The three early-return failure branches are not covered by a runtime test.
A failed GPU read is no longer reported as 0 on the wire or in the two components that read it, verified at hermetic unit and static scope only.
